summary: Cleanup-iteration regression verified end-to-end — nothing regressed. Backend: 18/18 pytest cases green (test_landing_checkout.py + test_usb_directflow_api.py). Backend lifespan migration is clean — supervisor shows 'Application startup complete' with no deprecation warnings; GET /api/ returns {'message':'USB DirectFlow API'}; POST /api/status + GET /api/status round-trips with model_dump() (no _id leaked, UUID id persisted); GET /api/samples returns 6 items including transfer-report.txt + telemetry.json; GET /api/sample-file/transfer-report.txt returns 'STREAM TRANSFER REPORT' text; GET /api/sample-file/telemetry.json returns 120 samples. Stripe (unconfigured): /api/checkout/config => {enabled:false, product:'Lifetime Access', amount_display:'$19.95', currency:'USD'}; POST /api/checkout/session => 503 with 'Stripe is not configured yet'; GET /api/checkout/status?session_id=bad => 400 'Invalid session ID'; cs_* => 503; POST /api/stripe/webhook => 503 (no secret). CORS wildcard works (allow_credentials=False). Frontend web landing '/': hero-headline 'Massive Files Directly to External Drives, Zero Phone Storage Required', pricing-card shows $19.95, feature-video / feature-pro / feature-astro, nav-buy / hero-buy / buy-button / hero-install all present and tappable; install-prompt auto-opens, install-dismiss hides it and dismissal persists across reload (AsyncStorage flag). All three buy affordances trigger POST /api/checkout/session => 503 and surface the info toast 'Checkout isn't live yet — add your Stripe key to enable purchases.' — no crash, no navigation. /success without session_id shows 'Something went wrong — Missing checkout session.' and success-home routes back to '/'. CRITICAL BUG-FIX VERIFIED: on (tabs) Transfer, toggling source to PHONE MEDIA renders pick-media + pick-doc; clicking pick-doc on web does NOT crash, no red-screen, no unhandled rejection — the new try/catch surfaces gracefully (web file dialog may no-op). Native simulated-drive flow on web: connect-button attaches SIM-USB 32G, sample-ForBiggerBlazes.mp4 selectable, start-button runs the stream to completion (STREAM CONSOLE shows DONE with 2.4 MB WRITTEN / 2.4 MB TOTAL, 'Transfer complete'); Browse tab lists '1 files on drive · 2.4 MB' and ForBiggerBlazes.mp4 row; tapping the row opens the preview with scrubber (video frame blank on web as expected). nav-install is only rendered on wide (desktop) viewport — expected responsive behavior, hero-install serves on mobile. No React Native red screens. Prior shadow*/pointerEvents console warnings flagged in iteration_2 appear to have been migrated — no new deprecation errors surfaced during this run.
action_items: No action required — cleanup iteration is clean. Backend 18/18 green, landing + /success flows intact, native simulated-drive E2E (connect → select sample → transfer → Browse → preview) still works, picker bug-fix verified (no crash, graceful toast path in place).

When Stripe keys are later supplied (STRIPE_SECRET_KEY + optional STRIPE_PRICE_ID + STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET), re-run the suite — /api/checkout/config should flip enabled:true, /api/checkout/session should return 200 with checkout_url+session_id, /api/checkout/status with real cs_ id should return paid/pending, and /api/stripe/webhook should verify signatures.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: @asynccontextmanager lifespan correctly replaces @app.on_event('shutdown') — client.close() runs after yield (iteration spec met).
server.py:53 uses status_obj.model_dump() (Pydantic v2) — correct replacement for deprecated .dict().
server.py:285-289 wraps the webhook stripe.checkout.Session.retrieve in try/except and raises 502 so Stripe will retry (idempotent upsert on session_id) — correct.
server.py:302-308 CORSMiddleware now uses allow_credentials=False with allow_origins=['*'] — valid combination (previously the combination was invalid).
(tabs)/index.tsx:118-168 pickMedia + pickDoc are wrapped in try/catch and surface toast.show('Could not open the ... picker', 'error') on failure — matches the specified bug-fix.
(tabs)/index.tsx:131, 154 — early-return on canceled/empty assets (no toast) is correct UX, no false error on cancel.
LandingPage/BrandEmblem/useCheckout: 503 is handled as info toast path, no uncaught promise rejections observed.
